title: How to reset your password
body: Go to the sign-in page and select 'Forgot password'. Enter the email on your account and we will send a reset link that is valid for one hour.

title: Why was my card declined
body: Card declines usually mean the billing address does not match your bank's records, the card expired, or the bank's fraud check blocked the charge. Try again with an updated card or contact your bank.

title: How to update your billing address
body: Open Account Settings, then Billing, then Payment Methods. Select the card and choose 'Edit address'. Changes apply to the next billing cycle.

title: Refund policy for annual plans
body: Annual plans can be refunded in full within 14 days of purchase. After 14 days we offer a prorated refund for unused months, minus a 10 percent processing fee.

title: How to cancel a subscription
body: Go to Account Settings, then Subscription, then 'Cancel plan'. Your plan stays active until the end of the current billing period; no partial-month refund is issued automatically.

title: App crashes on startup after an update
body: Force-quit the app, clear its cache from device settings, and reopen it. If it still crashes, uninstall and reinstall the latest version from the app store.

title: Two-factor authentication is not sending codes
body: Check that your phone has signal and that SMS is not blocked by a carrier spam filter. As a fallback, use the authenticator app codes generated from Account Settings, then Security.

title: How to export your data
body: From Account Settings, choose 'Export data'. We package your account data as a zip file and email a download link within 24 hours.

title: Changing your account email address
body: Go to Account Settings, then Profile, then 'Change email'. You must confirm the change from a link sent to the new address before it takes effect.

title: Invoice shows the wrong tax amount
body: Tax is calculated from the billing address on file at the time of the charge. Update the address for future invoices; past invoices cannot be recalculated automatically, contact support for a correction.

title: How to add a teammate to your workspace
body: Open Workspace Settings, then Members, then 'Invite'. Enter their email; they receive an invite link that expires after 7 days.

title: Removing a teammate from your workspace
body: Open Workspace Settings, then Members, select the teammate, and choose 'Remove'. Their seat is freed immediately and stops billing on the next cycle.

title: Upgrading from the free plan to a paid plan
body: Open Account Settings, then Subscription, then 'Upgrade'. Choose a plan and enter payment details; the upgrade takes effect immediately and you are billed a prorated amount for the rest of the month.

title: Downgrading your plan
body: Open Account Settings, then Subscription, then 'Change plan'. Downgrades take effect at the start of the next billing cycle so you keep current features until then.

title: API requests are returning 429 errors
body: A 429 means you have exceeded your plan's rate limit. Check the Retry-After header and back off requests accordingly, or upgrade your plan for a higher limit.

title: API key was leaked, how to rotate it
body: Go to Account Settings, then API Keys, and select 'Revoke' next to the compromised key. Generate a new key immediately; the old key stops working within a minute.

title: How to enable single sign-on
body: Single sign-on is available on the Enterprise plan. Open Workspace Settings, then Security, then 'Configure SSO', and follow the SAML setup wizard with your identity provider's metadata.

title: File upload fails with a size limit error
body: Individual file uploads are capped at 100 MB on the free plan and 1 GB on paid plans. Split large files or upgrade your plan to raise the limit.

title: Notifications are not arriving by email
body: Check your spam folder and confirm notifications are enabled in Account Settings, then Notifications. Some corporate email filters block automated mail; add our sending domain to your allowlist.

title: How to delete your account permanently
body: Open Account Settings, then Danger Zone, then 'Delete account'. This is irreversible after a 30-day grace period during which you can contact support to restore it.

title: Dark mode is not saving as my preference
body: Theme preference is stored per browser. If you clear cookies or use a private window, it resets to system default. Signing in on a new device requires setting it again there.

title: Mobile app is not syncing with the web app
body: Sync runs every few minutes when the app is in the foreground. Pull down to refresh to force an immediate sync, and confirm both apps are signed into the same account.

title: How billing cycles align with usage-based plans
body: Usage-based plans bill on the first of each month for the previous month's usage. Mid-cycle plan changes are prorated based on the number of days at each tier.

title: Payment failed and account was suspended
body: After three failed payment retries over 7 days, the account is suspended. Update your payment method in Account Settings, then Billing, and the account reactivates automatically within minutes.

title: How to report a security vulnerability
body: Email security reports to security@example.com with reproduction steps. Do not open a public support ticket for vulnerabilities; we respond to security reports within 48 hours.

title: Webhook deliveries are failing
body: Check that your endpoint returns a 2xx status within 5 seconds. Failed deliveries are retried with exponential backoff for 24 hours, then dropped; view delivery logs in Workspace Settings, then Webhooks.

title: How to request an itemized invoice for accounting
body: Open Account Settings, then Billing, then Invoices, and download the PDF next to any charge. Itemized invoices include per-seat and usage line items automatically.

title: Trial period ended and features are locked
body: Trials last 14 days. Once expired, add a payment method in Account Settings, then Subscription to keep full access; your data is retained but read-only until you upgrade.

title: Custom domain is not verifying
body: DNS changes can take up to 24 hours to propagate. Confirm the TXT and CNAME records match exactly what is shown in Workspace Settings, then Domains, and retry verification after propagation.

title: Difference between admin and member roles
body: Admins can manage billing, members, and workspace settings. Members can use the product but cannot invite or remove teammates, change the plan, or view invoices.
